Selected projects

01
Machine LearningExplainable AIPower BIMaster's Thesis

Member churn prediction with Explainable AI

End-to-end ML pipeline built on real, unprocessed membership data from a Norwegian professional association — from raw data to interactive Power BI dashboards used internally for decision support.

  • Data cleaning, feature engineering, and model training with XGBoost and LightGBM on real-world anonymized data
  • SHAP (Explainable AI) to make predictions interpretable for non-technical decision-makers
  • 5-page interactive Power BI dashboard with progressive disclosure logic and point-in-time prediction indicators
  • Code versioned and documented in Git — anonymized and publicly available
View code on GitHub ↗

NLPLLMsPythonGrade: A

NLP pipeline: topic modeling and LLM evaluation

Built a full NLP pipeline to map research themes in academic literature on churn and retention, combining classical topic modeling with GPT-4o-mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash evaluation.

  • Academic abstract collection via Crossref and Semantic Scholar APIs
  • Full pipeline: tokenization, lemmatization, LDA topic modeling, Naive Bayes classification
  • LLM evaluation using ROUGE scores — comparing GPT-4o-mini vs Gemini 2.5 Flash vs human summaries
  • Exam project in Data Analytics with Generative AI and Large Language Models

02

Dashboard walkthrough

The master's thesis produced a 5-page interactive Power BI dashboard for a Norwegian professional association. Each page serves a distinct decision-support purpose — from population-level risk overview to individual member explanation. All member values are anonymized.

Persistent shell
Navigation & information layer

A persistent sidebar spans all five pages with a reset-filter button, predicted date, and an information button that opens plain-language explanations on demand — keeping the main interface clean while making guidance accessible.

  • Five-page progressive navigation always visible
  • Reset filters to prevent hidden context from distorting interpretation
  • Plain-language info panels triggered on demand, not by default
Page 1 of 5
Overview

The first page gives managers a fast population-level picture before diving into detail. It combines KPI cards, a risk distribution donut, geographic map, and economic exposure toggle.

  • Risk band distribution across Low, Moderate, and High
  • Economic exposure toggle: expected loss vs revenue at risk
  • Geographic map showing risk concentration by local branch
  • Predicted date indicator — scores are point-in-time, not permanent
Page 2 of 5
Risk segments

Compare risk across segments like age group, billing frequency, education phase, or local branch. A ranked bar chart and bubble plot separate high-risk from large-but-low-risk groups.

  • Six segmentation dimensions selectable via filter panel
  • Ranked bar chart for quick risk prioritization
  • Bubble plot to distinguish risk level from organizational scale
  • Segment-level SHAP explanation panel populated on selection
Interaction flow
Segment-level explanation

Selecting a segment populates an explanation panel with the top risk-increasing and risk-reducing SHAP drivers for that group.

  • Step 1: choose segmentation dimension
  • Step 2: select a segment in chart or bubble plot
  • Step 3: explanation panel appears with SHAP-based drivers
Page 3 of 5
Member list

A ranked member table with search and filter options. Risk-band tabs let managers move between High, Moderate, and Low priority groups.

  • Ranked table with churn score, risk group, product, and branch
  • Search field and operational filter panel for targeted lookup
  • Risk-band tabs for prioritization view switching
  • Member-level summary card populated on row selection
Interaction flow
Member-level detail & explanation

Selecting a member populates a summary card with risk score, rank, profile, engagement over the past 180 days, and the top 5 SHAP-based risk drivers.

  • Risk score, predicted probability, and rank in risk band
  • Member profile: age group, product, local branch, billing frequency
  • Days since arrival and recent participation indicators
  • Top 5 individual SHAP drivers with plain-language labels
Page 4 of 5
Risk drivers

Global explanation layer showing which features the model relies on most, with a SHAP beeswarm plot and plain-language reading guide built into the dashboard.

  • Global feature importance cards ranked by SHAP weight
  • Separate views for drivers that increase vs reduce risk
  • SHAP beeswarm plot with built-in explanation panel
  • Membership length, employer info, and billing frequency as top drivers
Page 5 of 5
Model quality

Makes model limitations visible so advisors can judge reliability. Includes prioritization metrics, risk-band calibration, confusion matrix, and model comparison.

  • PR-AUC, Lift@5%, Precision@5%, and Recall@5% metric cards
  • Actual churn rate by predicted risk band — calibration check
  • Confusion matrix with Top 1% / Top 5% toggle
  • XGBoost selected as best performing model
